zoe_releng: deploybot flagged a caching regression in canary for /complete. Autorevert will kick. Can we hold for a fast config revert and a short monitor?

deploybot: ALERT: Canary cache-hit-rate dropped to 62% (baseline 95%). Autorevert in 90s unless overridden. details: https://telemetry/redwood/cache/1791239

pat_oncall: oncall here. Any errors or just cache misses?

leo_eng: just misses, no 5xx. New config toggles aggressive TTL reduction (PR 734) causing premature invalidation on long-turn conversations.

maria_csm: FYI customers using long chats might see slightly higher latency. If prod is touched we should inform CSMs.

zoe_releng: propose: short hold (10m) while we revert the TTL tweak on canary and run smoke. If revert passes, promote. If not, pin prod route to stable model.

pat_oncall: applying hold. `deploybot override --thread 1791239999 --hold 600 --reason \"investigate cache regression\"`

deploybot: ACTION: Autorevert HOLD applied by pat_oncall for 600s. Manual rollback still allowed.

leo_eng: reverting PR 734 now: `git revert --no-commit 734 && infra/deploy --env canary --tag v3.8.4-revert-ttl`

leo_eng: revert done at 1791230030. smoke: ```smoke: cache-hit-rate 94%; p95 back to baseline; no 5xx```

maria_csm: drafting CSM note: "We observed a cache invalidation regression in canary tied to TTL tuning. We've held automated rollback and reverted the config; no production impact observed. Monitoring ongoing."

zoe_releng: promoted canary to green at 1791230065. I'll post release-note blurb and link PR.

pat_oncall: canceling hold. `deploybot override --thread 1791239999 --hold-cancel`

deploybot: NOTICE: Autorevert HOLD canceled by pat_oncall. Normal autorevert policy restored.

leo_eng: creating follow-up ticket to add a perf gate for TTL changes and better canary telemetry (ENG-ops-520).

zoe_releng: closing loop. Short and clean, thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
